xref.title: Accidental Simply Red Stage Invasion
xref.body: One day, due to being heavily intoxicated, Shaun Ryder overslept and missed his bandmates and roadies departing for a gig. Rushing to the venue, he mistakenly ran onto the stage of Simply Red, who were performing a few doors down, believing it was the Happy Mondays' stage. "Unfortunately, he went into the wrong place. He accidentally invaded the stage of simply red. The Mondays were playing a few doors down."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Sex Pistols Manchester Show
xref.body: The Buzzcocks arranged for a still-unknown band, The Sex Pistols, to play the Lesser Free Trade Hall in Manchester on June 4th, 1976. This gig became mythical and legendary, inspiring about 40 attendees to form bands like Joy Division, Pet Shop Boys, Simply Red, and The Smiths, and to establish Factory Records. "They arranged for a still unknown band called The Sex Pistols to play the lesser free trade hall in Manchester on June 4th, 1976, a show that has gone down in myth and legend as one of the most important gigs in the history of rock."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
